info.title: Pushkar Clinic Patient App API
info.description: Patient APIs for all 24 mobile screens. Patient and staff JWT audiences are separate. All clinical access requires an explicit profile-to-clinic link. Providers are disabled until configured.

PatientBearer.description: Patient access_token from OTP verification; staff tokens are not accepted.

StaffBearer.description: Existing clinic staff login token, with per-route role, permission, module and branch checks.
